SELECT u.username, u.email, u.keywords,
       to_char(u.send_time, 'HH24:MI') AS send_time, u.timezone, u.active,
       COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(ut.topic_slug ORDER BY ut.topic_slug)
                 FROM user_topics ut WHERE ut.user_id = u.id), '{}') AS topics,
       (SELECT array_agg(slug ORDER BY slug) FROM topics) AS available_topics
FROM users u
WHERE u.id = $1::uuid;

WITH requested AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb) AS slug
), valid AS (
  SELECT r.slug FROM requested r JOIN topics t ON t.slug = r.slug
), removed AS (
  DELETE FROM user_topics
  WHERE user_id = $1::uuid
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM valid)
    AND topic_slug NOT IN (SELECT slug FROM valid)
), added AS (
  INSERT INTO user_topics (user_id, topic_slug)
  SELECT $1::uuid, slug FROM valid
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
)
SELECT
  COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(slug ORDER BY slug) FROM valid), '{}') AS topics,
  COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(slug ORDER BY slug) FROM requested
            WHERE slug NOT IN (SELECT slug FROM valid)), '{}') AS unknown,
  (SELECT array_agg(slug ORDER BY slug) FROM topics) AS available_topics;

UPDATE users
SET keywords = ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($2::jsonb))
WHERE id = $1::uuid
RETURNING keywords;

UPDATE users
SET send_time = $2::time,
    timezone = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), timezone)
WHERE id = $1::uuid
  AND (NULLIF($3, '') IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_timezone_names WHERE name = $3))
RETURNING to_char(send_time, 'HH24:MI') AS send_time, timezone;

SELECT u.username, u.email, u.keywords,
       to_char(u.send_time, 'HH24:MI') AS send_time, u.timezone, u.active, u.role,
       to_char(u.consent_at AT TIME ZONE u.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS consent_at,
       to_char(u.created_at AT TIME ZONE u.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS created_at,
       COALESCE((SELECT array_agg(ut.topic_slug ORDER BY ut.topic_slug)
                 FROM user_topics ut WHERE ut.user_id = u.id), '{}') AS topics,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM newsletters n WHERE n.user_id = u.id)::int AS newsletters_received,
       (SELECT to_char(max(n.sent_at) AT TIME ZONE u.timezone, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')
          FROM newsletters n WHERE n.user_id = u.id) AS last_newsletter_at,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM sessions s
         WHERE s.user_id = u.id AND s.expires_at > now())::int AS active_sessions
FROM users u
WHERE u.id = $1::uuid;
